release.content: pubkit 0.27.1 was released on 2026-11-05 from commit c6d961cb4506412c3184f85d8cd7cb3b0cffd65c with these changes.

rows: pubkit's nightly installs, and pins release workflows to, the newest pubrel crates.io has, warning when its latest GitHub release isn't published there yet, so a tag published before its crate no longer stops every repository's nightly.

pubkit secrets run -- COMMAND runs one command with the Bitwarden secrets the repository's with-secrets.json names, exactly as the managed ./with-secrets does (the same settings, .env token, aliases, Terraform modes and messages), so a repository can run it from its pinned pubkit instead of keeping the script. --cwd runs the command in another directory.
